data.name: BmsPointGrid_Description
data.value: Read-only current BMS Point dataset grid.

data.name: ObjectId_Description
data.value: Metasys source Object ID for the Point.

data.name: CurrentValue_Description
data.value: Latest numeric reading; it can be empty.

data.name: LastReadingTime_Description
data.value: UTC time of the current reading.

data.name: SourceSystem_Description
data.value: Source system that supplied the Point.

data.name: StaleAfterMinutes_Description
data.value: Minutes before the UI labels a reading as stale; this does not change data.

data.name: AgentWebChatUrl_Description
data.value: Public HTTPS Web Chat embed URL from Copilot Studio. Anyone with the URL can access the agent.
